title: 连接执中账号
description: 请填写您申请的执中 API Key。凭证由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机，连接时发送至执中服务进行认证；可用数据与额度以您的执中账号权限为准。
description_en: Enter your ZERONE API Key. WorkBuddy stores it locally and sends it to ZERONE for authentication. Access and quota follow your ZERONE account.
docLabel: 注册执中账号并申请 API Key
docLabel_en: Register and request an API Key

fields.label: 执中 API Key
fields.placeholder: 填写在执中申请的 API Key
fields.description: 访问 https://ai.zerone.com.cn 注册账号并申请 API Key。仅填写 Key 本身，不要添加 Bearer 前缀。
fields.description_en: Register at https://ai.zerone.com.cn and request an API Key. Enter only the key, without the Bearer prefix.
